utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hi Dane, I’m still working from second-hand updates, so I don’t want to overstate anything—have you heard a confirmed time for Sam’s group joining Mara’s crew this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I haven’t heard a confirmed time yet, Nell, so I’d rather not put one down until Sam or Mara verifies it. If you hear directly from either of them, I’ll add it to the clean list.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Dane—that matches what I’ve heard, so I won’t pass along a time yet. I’ll check back with Jules or wait for Sam or Mara to confirm before saying anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Opal — we’re centering the repair drive on Saturday from 10 to noon, since Faye can cover check-in or sorting then and Quinn’s spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That works, Mara—let’s keep Saturday 10 to noon as the working window, but I’m still waiting on Sam’s check of the community room tables and east entrance supplies before I place his group.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good, Opal — let’s hold Saturday 10 to noon as the firm window, with Faye on check-in or sorting, and wait for Sam’s table and east entrance update before assigning his group.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Noah, I’m still happy to pitch in for the repair drive—just tell me the day and what kinds of fixes folks are bringing, and I’ll pack the right tools.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Gus—I haven’t got the day pinned down yet, but Leo wants us to start with broken locks, active leaks, and no heat once Rosa’s list comes in, so tools for those would be perfect.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Got it, Noah—I’ll set aside my lock tools, plumbing kit, and a few heating basics, and once Rosa’s list and the day are set I’ll fine-tune what I bring.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hi Vik—I’ll check that list like I promised and let you know if we’re short on any tools before folks start showing up around 10.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Oren—I’ll keep telling folks to come around 10, and I’ll wait on your note about any missing tools before I say more.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Will do, Vik—I’m heading to look at the list now, and I’ll send you a note as soon as I know what tools we’re missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hi Kira—I’ve got folks starting to bring things by around 10, and I’m checking my notes now for any broken locks, active leaks, or no-heat cases to send Rosa first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Cleo—before I pass that along, can you confirm Opal is organizing the repair drive and that 10 o’clock drop-off is official?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I wouldn’t say Opal’s organizing it—Vik’s handling the outreach, Rosa’s sorting the safety priorities, and yes, 10 in the morning is the drop-off time I’ve been telling folks.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Ira, I’m spreading the word that the repair drive’s key window is Saturday from 10 to noon, with Faye helping then—can you pass that along to your side of the block?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yes, I’ll pass along that Saturday 10 to noon is the key window and Faye’s helping then. I’m also still trying to pin down who’s bringing drills, ladders, and extension cords for Mina.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Ira—that’s a big help. I’ll mention Saturday 10 to noon as I keep inviting folks, and if I hear who can bring drills, ladders, or extension cords, I’ll send them Mina’s way.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Let’s wait for Rosa’s call list, then sort it by broken locks, active leaks, and no heat first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, that order makes sense, Leo — I just want to make sure Rosa’s list has addresses and callback numbers so we don’t send volunteers in circles.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Good point. I’ll ask Rosa to include address, callback number, and the repair issue for each person.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hi Hana! The repair drive’s moving along—Mara’s crew is sorting tools, and I’m waiting on Sam’s report before I share any firm times or spots for extra hands this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’ll hold off on sharing any times or locations until Sam’s report is in. Can you confirm whether Mara’s crew has fully committed to tool sorting, and who verified that?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can confirm Mara’s crew is sorting tools, but I don’t want to call it a full weekend commitment until I check back with Mara directly.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Rey, quick update: the repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, and we’re prioritizing broken locks, active leaks, and no heat first. Do you know anyone who should be on that urgent list?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Rosa—that helps. I don’t know anyone urgent yet, but I’ll ask quietly around my building today and tell you if I hear of broken locks, leaks, or no heat.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Rey, that would be a big help—just send me any names you hear today, and I’ll make sure they’re near the top of the Sunday list at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hi Uli — I’m checking who’s coordinating the repair drive before I spread any start time around, just so nobody shows up too early.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Hi Tess — Quinn was bringing the details by and helping spread the word, so they may know the start time. I’m staying a bit quiet right now, but I appreciate you checking first.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Uli — I’ll check with Quinn next, then circle back to Pia before I tell my block anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Eli, do you have confirmed names for who’s bringing drills, ladders, and extension cords to the repair drive, and what time Sam’s group is showing up?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Not confirmed yet, Mina—I’m making the list now, and I’ll check on the drills, ladders, cords, and Sam’s arrival time before I pass anything along.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Eli—please get me firm names and Sam’s arrival time tonight, not estimates, so I can see what we’re still short on.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Sam—quick version, I’m trying to confirm the repair drive before I repeat it around. Have you heard if Mara’s actually organizing Saturday 10 to noon?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ve only heard Opal is coordinating the repair drive, Bo, so I don’t want to confirm Mara or the Saturday 10 to noon time until I check back.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Sam—that’s exactly the kind of wrinkle I needed to catch. I’ll hold off on telling Kira anything firm until I verify whether it’s Opal or Mara and the actual time.
